description: This file provides cryptographic utility functions, including GUID creation, SHA-1 hashing, ASN.1/DER encoding, and self-signed certificate generation, primarily used for security and certificate handling within the project.

classes.name: DER
classes.description: A class providing static methods for ASN.1/DER encoding, including sequence, integer, object identifier, null, set, explicit context-dependent, printable string, bit string, date, and internal encoding helpers.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a new GUID using cryptographically secure random bytes, returned as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-1 hash of a given Buffer or string input.

methods.name: generateSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Creates a self-signed X.509 certificate with RSA key pair, valid for one year, encoded in PEM format.
